lead.headline: In Ecuador's Los Ríos province, 29 of 66 town-hall public-works tenders drew one bidder; about 7-8 was expected
lead.number: 29 of 66 (44%) one-bidder works tenders in Jan-Jun 2026 records, highest of 24 provinces (coastal town halls elsewhere 15%, Guayas 21%); $13.4M of $28.8M, $6.3M of it one Quevedo contract
lead.watch_out: RECORD_DATE is the release date, not the award date: about a third are late-2025 tenders and 2025 holds no tenders, so there's no year-over-year; one bidder is a screen, not proof

sources.quote: Con la participación de un solo oferente se efectuaron 42,6 % de todos los procesos de contratación pública adjudicados bajo régimen común de los últimos seis años, en Ecuador.
The proportion of single-bid tenders in open procedures is also trending downward since 2015, decreasing from 29% in 2015 to 20.5% in June 2022.
